mapper.select: select organization_code from evaluation_organization_mappings where user_id = #{userId} and business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' order by case data_scope when 'SELF' then 0 when 'DEPARTMENT' then 1 when 'COLLEGE' then 2 when 'BUSINESS' then 3 else 4 end, mapping_id limit 1
mapper.sql: from degree_completion_achievements a join users u on u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots p on p.employee_no = u.employee_no where a.deleted_at is null and (a.teacher_user_id = #{userId} or exists ( select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings m where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and m.organization_code = a.organization_code and m.data_scope in ('DEPARTMENT', 'COLLEGE', 'BUSINESS', 'ALL') )) and a.management_no ilike concat('%', #{criteria.managementNo}, '%') and p.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.teacherName}, '%') and a.achievement_status = #{criteria.certificationStatus}

a.achievement_id as "achievementId", a.management_no as "managementNo", a.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", a.organization_code as "organizationCode", a.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", p.name as "teacherName", a.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date as "occurredDate", a.achievement_status as "certificationStatus", a.detail_payload::text as "achievementDetail", a.attachment_count as "attachmentCount", (a.occurrence_date_warning_yn = 'Y') as "occurrenceDateWarning"
mapper.select: select from degree_completion_achievements a join users u on u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots p on p.employee_no = u.employee_no where a.achievement_id = #{achievementId} and a.deleted_at is null

select degree_completion_student_id as "degreeCompletionStudentId", degree_type as "degreeType", student_name as "studentName", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", degree_awarded_date as "degreeAwardedDate" from degree_completion_students where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by degree_awarded_date, degree_completion_student_id
mapper.insert: insert into degree_completion_achievements (management_no, evaluation_year, organization_code, teacher_user_id, management_item_code, achievement_date, achievement_status, detail_payload, attachment_count, occurrence_date_warning_yn, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{managementNo}, #{evaluationYear}, #{organizationCode}, #{teacherUserId}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, #{certificationStatus}, cast(#{achievementDetail} as jsonb), #{attachmentCount}, case when #{occurrenceDateWarning} then 'Y' else 'N' end, #{teacherUserId}, #{teacherUserId}, '석·박사 배출 실적 저장')

insert into degree_completion_students (achievement_id, degree_type, student_name, thesis_title, degree_awarded_date, created_by) values (#{achievementId}, #{student.degreeType}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.thesisTitle}, #{student.degreeAwardedDate}, #{createdBy})

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values ('degree_completion_achievements', cast(#{achievementId} as varchar), #{changeType}, 'header_and_students', #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{requestId})
mapper.select: select #{userId} = #{ownerUserId} or exists ( select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings where user_id = #{userId} and organization_code = #{organizationCode} and business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' )
select exists (select 1 from evaluation_result_locks where evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and organization_code = #{organizationCode} and confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, transition_reason, processed_by, processed_at, request_id) values (#{achievementType}, #{achievementId}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{transitionReason}, #{processedBy}, #{processedAt}, #{requestId})
